ValidationRule.description: Only opted-in won opportunities require handoff details.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(SH_Enabled__c, IsWon, OR(ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(SH_Contact_Email__c), ISBLANK(SH_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(TRIM(SH_Success_Criteria__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Handoff requires an Account, Contact Email, Requested Start Date, and Customer Success Criteria. Complete these fields before saving this won opportunity.
